<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR introduces a reusable test helper `waitForRemoteWorkloadToBeDeleted` to check for remote workload deletion on a worker cluster, alongside supporting imports. Two existing integration test scenarios replace inline deletion-check logic with calls to this helper, reducing duplication.

## Changes

**Remote workload deletion test helper**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Import dependencies and helper function definition** <br> `test/integration/multikueue/jobs_test.go` | Adds `fmt` and `apierrors` imports. Introduces `waitForRemoteWorkloadToBeDeleted` helper that polls the worker for a remote workload, succeeds on `IsNotFound`, and otherwise returns detailed diagnostics (UID, finalizers, deletion timestamp) to distinguish between deletion-in-progress and still-existing states. |
| **Test scenarios refactored to use deletion helper** <br> `test/integration/multikueue/jobs_test.go` | "Requeue with connection loss" and "connection reconnect" test scenarios replace inline workload-not-found checks with calls to the new `waitForRemoteWorkloadToBeDeleted` helper. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~8 minutes
